invalidConfig.en-US: Invalid Distill {field}: {reason}. Processing is disabled until the configuration is repaired.
invalidConfig.zh-CN: Distill 配置 {field} 无效：{reason}。修复配置前停止处理。

configObject.en-US: expected an object with supported fields
configObject.zh-CN: 应为仅含支持字段的对象

configBytes.en-US: expected a positive safe integer within the documented byte limit
configBytes.zh-CN: 应为文档字节上限内的正安全整数

configCommands.en-US: expected at most 32 nonempty literal command prefixes, each at most 256 characters
configCommands.zh-CN: 应为最多 32 个非空字面命令前缀，每项不超过 256 字符

summaryNotice.en-US: Model summary; individual claims are not locally verified. Read the source for exact context.
summaryNotice.zh-CN: 模型摘要，未在本地逐项核验事实；精确上下文请读取原文。

evidenceNotice.en-US: Exact quotes verified against the source; coverage and evidence labels are not guaranteed. Tool status is not a test verdict.
evidenceNotice.zh-CN: 已核对引文来源；不保证覆盖完整或证据分类正确。工具状态不等于测试结论。

readback.en-US: Read source_artifact with native read (offset/limit; outputRequest=RAW when applicable). Tail N lines: offset=max(1, source_lines-N+1).
readback.zh-CN: 使用原生 read 的 offset/limit 读取 source_artifact（适用时传 outputRequest=RAW）。最后 N 行起点：max(1, source_lines-N+1)。

outputRequest.en-US: Result handling request: exactly RAW bypasses processing; otherwise describe what to retain. Diagnostic evidence uses exact source quotes, not diagnoses. For fused edit/write this applies only to then_run output; when optional and omitted, use default evidence rules.
outputRequest.zh-CN: 结果处理要求：严格传入 RAW 跳过处理；其他文本说明要保留的信息。诊断证据只引用原文，不做诊断。融合 edit/write 中仅作用于 then_run 输出；可选且省略时使用默认证据规则。

contract.en-US: Distill-controlled tools: {tools}. Apply these rules only to this list, not other tools' business fields. For tools with a required outputRequest, always supply a nonempty request or exactly RAW. Optional outputRequest on fused edit/write controls only then_run diagnostic logs; omission uses default evidence rules. RAW bypasses Distill, not the underlying tool's own limits. Use native read with RAW to inspect source_artifact; source_lines supports one-call tail reads. Evidence receipts verify quotes, not completeness or test outcomes; ordinary summaries are not fact-verified.
contract.zh-CN: Distill 控制的工具：{tools}。以下规则仅作用于此列表，不作用于其他工具的业务字段。工具要求 outputRequest 时必须传非空处理要求或严格的 RAW。融合 edit/write 的可选 outputRequest 仅控制 then_run 诊断日志，省略时使用默认证据规则。RAW 跳过 Distill，不解除底层工具自身限制。通过原生 read 配合 RAW 回读 source_artifact；source_lines 可用于一次定位尾部。证据收据只核对引文，不保证完整性或测试结论；普通摘要未逐项核验事实。

schemaCollision.en-US: Tool {tool} already owns outputRequest; Distill leaves its schema and execution untouched.
schemaCollision.zh-CN: 工具 {tool} 已拥有 outputRequest；Distill 不修改其 schema 或执行参数。

fusionSetting.zh-CN: 融合命令证据（需开启诊断证据）：{value}

archiveFailure.en-US: Source could not be archived; original tool output retained.
archiveFailure.zh-CN: 无法归档原文，已保留原工具输出。

processingFailure.en-US: Result processing failed or was cancelled; original tool output retained.
processingFailure.zh-CN: 结果处理失败或已取消，保留原工具输出。

evidenceRejected.en-US: Evidence was rejected; original tool output retained without a summary fallback.
evidenceRejected.zh-CN: 证据未通过校验，保留原工具输出，不降级为普通摘要。
